summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for creation of the security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of the Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 10. The Petitioner, Nangalbibra-Bongaigaon Transmission Limited, has filed the present Petition under Section 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”) read with Regulation 6 (8) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 (hereinafter referred to as "Transmission License Regulations”) to seek the approval over the Petitioner’s Assets and to secure the total commitment to the New Lenders and its subsequent transferees, assignees, _(b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner over the Petitioner’s Assets to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the total commitment to the New Lenders aggregating to Rs. 520,00,00,000/- (Rupees Five Hundred Twenty) Crores only, in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 10 for the benefit of the New Lender;_ _(c) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner over the Petitioner’s Assets to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the total commitment to the New Lenders aggregating to Rs. 520,00,00,000/- (Rupees Five Hundred Twenty Crores only), in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 10 for the benefit of the New Lenders and its subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage;_ _(e) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case."_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, in terms of Articles 15.2.2 and 15.2.4 of the Transmission Service Agreement, it is entitled to create encumbrances over the Project Assets only in accordance with the terms of the TSA and with necessary consents, including compliance with regulatory approvals as required under the applicable law, subject to obtaining prior approval from this Commission. 6. The matter was admitted on 5.6.2025, and notices were issued to the parties to file their respective replies. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents. 7. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing on 5.6.2025, the Petitioner was directed to submit information regarding the application of funds and sources of funds as on the date of the filing of the Petition. The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 18.6.2025, in compliance with the RoP dated 5.6.2025, has submitted the requisite information, which has been placed on record. 8. During the course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner primarily reiterated the submissions made in the Petition and further submitted that the Project of the Petitioner was commissioned on 26.11.2024. Considering the submissions of the parties, the Commission reserved the matter for order. 10. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Commission, vide Order dated 3.11.2022 in Petition No. 260/MP/2022, granted approval under Section Sub-sections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act for creation of security interest over all assets, including movable 12. In addition to the above, in compliance with RoP dated 3.7.2025, the Petitioner Petitioner has submitted that from the date of commissioning of the Project and up to been maintained in its accounts for being utilized towards future requirements of the Project. The Petitioner has placed on record the copy of ‘No due certificate’ dated 9.4.2025 issued by the Previous lenders. _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or subsection (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void.”_ 19. We, therefore, accord in-principle approval to the First Petitioner to create a security interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited acting as Security Trustee on behalf of the Secured Parties and other secured parties, and their respective successors, assignees, novatees and transferees as per the Facility Agreement dated 8.4.2025 (as amended and supplemented). 20. This in-principle approval is being approved with the condition that the transmission licence granted by the Commission to the Petitioner shall not be assigned in favour of the Debenture Trustee or any nominee of the Debenture Holders without the prior approval of the Commission. In the event of any such proposal, the Commission shall assess the technical and financial capability of the proposed nominee with respect to the development, design, construction, operation, and maintenance of transmission systems and its ability to execute and operate the licensed transmission project. The Petitioner, the Debenture Trustee, the Debenture Holders, and the nominee shall be jointly required to approach the Commission to seek such prior approval. This will allow the Commission to satisfy itself of the circumstances necessitating such a transfer. This decision of ours is in accordance with Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of Transmission Licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2024, which reads as under: 21.
